texto.titulo: Tired but proud / Cansada, mas orgulhosa
texto.ru: Laura has been studying for six hours and she is exhausted. She has been preparing for an important exam since Monday. It has been raining all week, so she hasn't been going out much. How long has she been living in this city? For three years. She has been working part-time too, which has made her life busier. But she has been learning a lot, and she feels proud of herself.
texto.pt: Laura estuda há seis horas e está exausta. Ela se prepara para uma prova importante desde segunda. Tem chovido a semana inteira, então ela não tem saído muito. Há quanto tempo ela mora nesta cidade? Há três anos. Ela também tem trabalhado meio período, o que deixou a vida dela mais corrida. Mas tem aprendido muito e sente orgulho de si mesma.

perguntas.pergunta: How long has Laura been studying today?
Why hasn't she been going out much?
perguntas.resposta: It has been raining all week.
